# The ejected group stage builds with upstream Go and prints the same lines
# as the native build: the fixture holds the value form and the range form
# over every source kind, with the early-stop terminals and the channel
# operations in segment lambdas.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1273/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.3 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstageeject

go 1.27
